limitations: head_ids reaches the arXiv/HF documentation channel only, so §4's 'not cited anywhere at HEAD' is honoured for that channel and not for DOIs, PMIDs, source comments or notebooks.
Control listings are drawn from six monthly slices of the half-year rather than the whole window; the per-slice cap is an unregistered narrowing, recorded in §4.
Controls may be shared across clusters, a correlation the repository-cluster bootstrap does not capture, so the interval is very slightly too narrow.
X5's language detector is absent, so the population is not filtered for English prose (§2.2).
Adoption dates cover 44 of 94 legacy positives and are missing where repositories are largest (§5).
